title: The $6.3 Billion Binance Hack Explained 🚨
alt_hooks: North Korea just stole $6.3 billion from Binance in under an hour.
How did hackers drain $6.3 billion from Binance in just 20 minutes?
The largest crypto hack in history just happened on Binance.

scenes.line: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance in under an hour.

shots.words: from Binance in under an hour.

scenes.line: Blockchain firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis linked it to North Korea on Thursday.

shots.words: and Chainalysis linked it to North Korea.

scenes.line: Attackers exploited an engineer laptop and EIP-7702 to drain hot wallets during the cyberattack.

shots.words: and EIP-7702 to drain hot wallets.

scenes.line: Stablecoin providers froze $2.8 billion, but about $3 billion vanished forever in the crypto heist.
Co-CEO Richard Teng vowed corporate funds will cover all customer losses from the security breach.

shots.words: corporate funds will cover all customer losses.

visual.name: Richard Teng
visual.text: We are committed to covering all hacked losses.

scenes.line: As withdrawals paused, Bitcoin crashed below $80,000 for the first time in a month following the exploit.

shots.words: Bitcoin crashed below $80,000 for the first time.

description: On October 30, 2026, Binance suffered a historic $6.3 billion cyberattack linked by TRM Labs and Chainalysis to North Korea's TraderTraitor group. Co-CEO Richard Teng confirmed that company reserves will cover all user losses, while stablecoin providers managed to freeze $2.8 billion of the stolen funds.
pinned: Would you keep your funds on an exchange after a hack this size?
